info.title: DotNetOpenApiExtract.Cli
info.description: CLI tool that extracts OpenAPI specifications from compiled .NET assemblies via static reflection — no application startup required

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Extract an OpenAPI specification from a compiled .NET assembly without running the application.

Program.cs is read as source code and never run, so configuration that exists only at run time is not seen: values from IConfiguration, appsettings and environment variables, anything computed at startup, and Swashbuckle filters (IDocumentFilter, IOperationFilter, ISchemaFilter) or AddOpenApi transformers. A value the tool recognizes but cannot compute is reported as a warning with its file:line and, where one exists, the flag that sets it. Document metadata is read from the OpenApiInfo of SwaggerDoc / AddOpenApi in Program.cs; a flag overrides it. Set document metadata explicitly with --title, --version, --description, --summary, --contact-name, --contact-email, --contact-url, --license-name, --license-url, --license-identifier, --terms-of-service and --server.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the .NET assembly DLL (produced by dotnet build)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path [default: swagger.json]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or yaml [default: json]

options.name: --title
options.description: API title. Defaults to [AssemblyTitle], then [AssemblyProduct], then the Title of SwaggerDoc / AddOpenApi in Program.cs, then DLL file name

options.name: --version
options.description: Document version (info.version). Defaults to the Version of SwaggerDoc / AddOpenApi in Program.cs, then v1

options.name: --description
options.description: API description written to the info block. Defaults to [AssemblyDescription], then the Description of SwaggerDoc / AddOpenApi in Program.cs

options.name: --xml
options.description: XML documentation file path. Can be specified multiple times — each path adds one more source. Sources are merged with first-added winning on key collision, so earlier --xml paths take priority. Project XML is auto-detected next to the DLL and added after explicit paths. Framework/SDK ref-pack XMLs are discovered automatically and added last. If an explicitly-provided file does not exist, a warning is printed to stderr and that entry is skipped.

options.name: --naming-policy
options.description: JSON property naming policy: preserve, camelCase (default), snake_case_lower, snake_case_upper, kebab-case-lower, kebab-case-upper

options.name: --enum-as-string
options.description: Serialize enum values as strings instead of integers [default: False]

options.name: --openapi-version
options.description: OpenAPI version the document is built, validated and serialized for: 3.0, 3.1, or 3.2. Any other value is an error (exit 2) [default: 3.0]

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: Path prefix to exclude from the generated spec (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --source
options.description: Path to a specific source file (e.g. entry point). Reserved for future use.

options.name: --source-root
options.description: Project root folder for Roslyn source analysis. When not specified, auto-detected by walking up from the DLL path to the first directory containing a .csproj. Pass explicitly only when sources and build artifacts are in separate directory trees.

options.name: --contact-name
options.description: Name of the contact person or organisation (written to info.contact.name)

options.name: --contact-email
options.description: Email address of the API contact (written to info.contact.email)

options.name: --contact-url
options.description: URL of the contact information page — must be an absolute URI (info.contact.url)

options.name: --license-name
options.description: SPDX license name, e.g. MIT or Apache-2.0 (written to info.license.name)

options.name: --license-url
options.description: URL pointing to the full license text — must be an absolute URI (info.license.url)

options.name: --license-identifier
options.description: SPDX license identifier, e.g. MIT (info.license.identifier, OpenAPI 3.1+; x-oai-license-identifier with a warning for 3.0). Needs --license-name; cannot be combined with --license-url

options.name: --summary
options.description: Short summary of the API (info.summary, OpenAPI 3.1+; omitted with a warning for 3.0). Wins over OpenApiInfo.Summary in Program.cs

options.name: --server-name
options.description: Name of a server (servers[].name, OpenAPI 3.2; x-oai-name with a warning before). Repeatable: the k-th --server-name names the k-th --server; give none or exactly one per --server

options.name: --self-url
options.description: URI reference of the document itself, without a fragment ($self, OpenAPI 3.2; x-oai-$self with a warning before)

options.name: --json-schema-dialect
options.description: JSON Schema dialect of the document (jsonSchemaDialect): the OAS dialect of the target version — https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/dialect/base for 3.1, https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.2/dialect/2025-09-17 for 3.2; for 3.0 either is accepted and omitted with a warning. Not written without the flag

options.name: --terms-of-service
options.description: URL to the Terms of Service for the API — must be an absolute URI (info.termsOfService)

options.name: --server
options.description: Server base URL to include in the servers array (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --path-base-emission
options.description: How to emit the path base detected via app.UsePathBase(): 'prefix' (default) prepends to every path, 'servers' adds a relative servers[] entry [default: prefix]

options.name: --no-enum-auto-description
options.description: Disable automatic markdown description on enum schemas. When set, schema.description gets only the type-level summary (old behavior). x-enum-descriptions is still emitted when values are documented. [default: False]

options.name: --no-enum-varnames
options.description: Disable the x-enum-varnames extension on enum schemas. [default: False]

options.name: --validate
options.description: Enable OpenAPI spec validation. 58 rules — 32 errors and 17 warnings run by default, 9 more are off by default. Error severity blocks CI (exit 1). Warnings are reported but do not fail by default. Use --strict to treat all warnings as errors. Off-by-default rules can be enabled with --enable-rule <id>. Disable individual rules via --skip-rule <id>. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-rule
options.description: Disable a specific validation rule by ID (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --min-description-length
options.description: Minimum characters required for description fields in validation rules (default: 5) [default: 5]

options.name: --exclude-validation-path
options.description: Path prefixes skipped by rules that require error responses (operation.has-error-response) and success responses (operation.success-response). Other rules are not affected. Repeatable. Default: none.

options.name: --validation-report
options.description: Write JSON validation report to this file path (if omitted, report is printed to stdout)

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat all Warning-severity violations as errors (exit 1 on any violation). Equivalent to promoting all warnings to errors. [default: False]

options.name: --warn-rule
options.description: Demote a specific rule from error to warning severity (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --error-rule
options.description: Promote a specific rule from warning to error severity (can be specified multiple times)

options.name: --enable-rule
options.description: Enable a rule that is off by default (can be specified multiple times). Off-by-default rule IDs: spec.servers-defined, tag.description, component.no-unused, spec.no-eval-in-markdown, spec.no-script-tags-in-markdown, operation.has-required-response-codes, operation.operation-id-pascal-case, schema.additional-properties-explicit, response.content-type-json-default

options.name: --require-response-code
options.description: Required response codes for specific HTTP methods. Format: METHOD:CODE. Method can be: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, QUERY, safe (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/TRACE/QUERY), mutating (any other method, including non-standard ones), or * for any. Repeatable. Activates operation.has-required-response-codes rule (requires --enable-rule). Example: --require-response-code mutating:422 --require-response-code *:401

options.name: --rule-min-length
options.description: Override --min-description-length for a specific rule. Format: RULE-ID:N. Repeatable. Applies to rules that check description length. Example: --rule-min-length enum.value-description:5 --rule-min-length operation.description:30
